mode.title: What to collect
mode.description: search: browse or search the market catalogue. itemOverview: one summary row per item (bid/ask, spread, 24h/7d/30d average price and volume, all-time high). priceHistory: the full median price and sales volume series. orderBook: every buy and sell price level. listings: individual items for sale with float, pattern seed and stickers. recentSales: the live feed of completed sales.

items.title: Items
items.description: For the item modes. Each line is an exact market name (e.g. AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)) or a market page URL from your browser. Leave empty to take the items from a search instead (see the search settings below).

appId.title: Game
appId.description: Which game's market. A Steam app id (730 = CS2, 570 = Dota 2, 440 = TF2, 252490 = Rust, 753 = Steam trading cards) or one of: cs2, dota2, tf2, rust, pubg, steam. Item URLs carry their own game and ignore this.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Steam prices everything in the currency of the visitor's country, so this picks the proxy country for you (USD = United States, EUR = Germany, ...). Needs Apify Proxy. Leave empty to use the proxy settings as they are. Search results are always in USD.

expandVariants.title: Include every variant of each item
expandVariants.description: Turn each item into all of its variants: every wear (Factory New ... Battle-Scarred), StatTrak and Souvenir version. A grouped market URL (ending in /G...) is always expanded.

searchQuery.title: Search text
searchQuery.description: Search mode, or item modes with no Items: text to search for (e.g. knife, case, redline). Leave empty to browse everything.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Used by the search mode, and by the item modes when the Items list is empty.

searchFilters.title: Category filters
searchFilters.description: Market category filters, as {"category": ["tag", ...]}. Examples for CS2: {"Type": ["CSGO_Type_WeaponCase"]} (cases), {"Exterior": ["WearCategory0"]} (Factory New), {"Rarity": ["Rarity_Ancient_Weapon"]} (Covert), {"Quality": ["strange"]} (StatTrak).

minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)
minPrice.description: Only items whose cheapest listing costs at least this much, in US dollars.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)
maxPrice.description: Only items whose cheapest listing costs at most this much, in US dollars.

maxItems.title: Maximum items from search
maxItems.description: How many catalogue items to return (search mode) or to pick from the search (item modes with no Items). Up to 100 items per request.

historyDays.title: History window (days)
historyDays.description: Price history mode: keep only the last N days of data points. 0 = everything since the item was first sold. Summary statistics (averages, all-time high) always use the full history.

historyOutput.title: History output shape
historyOutput.description: perItem: one row per item with all data points in a 'prices' list. perPoint: one row per data point (best for spreadsheets and charts).

orderBookDepth.title: Order book depth
orderBookDepth.description: How many price levels to return on each side of the order book. 0 = every level. Item overview always shows a 10-level preview.

maxListingsPerItem.title: Maximum listings per item
maxListingsPerItem.description: Listings mode: how many individual sell listings to collect for each item.

listingSort.title: Sort listings by
listingSort.description: Listings mode: price, float (wear) or pattern seed. Float sorting is how you find the lowest-wear copies of a skin.

minFloat.title: Minimum float
minFloat.description: Listings mode: skip listings with a float below this (e.g. 0.15). Leave empty for no limit.

maxFloat.title: Maximum float
maxFloat.description: Listings mode: skip listings with a float above this (e.g. 0.16). With 'Float: lowest first' sorting the run stops as soon as it passes this value.

includeFullDescription.title: Include full item description on every listing
includeFullDescription.description: Listings and recent sales: keep the full item description text and sticker artwork details on every row. Off keeps rows small.

recentSalesPolls.title: Number of polls
recentSalesPolls.description: Recent sales mode: Steam shows the latest 50 sales and refreshes them about every 30 seconds. Poll several times to build a longer feed; duplicates are removed.

recentSalesIntervalSecs.title: Seconds between polls
recentSalesIntervalSecs.description: Recent sales mode: wait between polls. The feed refreshes about every 30 seconds.

filterRecentSalesByApp.title: Only sales from the selected game
filterRecentSalesByApp.description: Recent sales mode: keep only sales for the game in the Game field. Off returns sales from every game.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: How many requests run at the same time.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is recommended: it spreads requests over many IPs and its country sets the currency of every price. The Currency field above overrides the country.
